knowledge_arcana.name: Knowledge (Arcana)
knowledge_arcana.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (arcana) gives +2 on Spellcraft checks. Identifies Constructs, Dragons, and Magical Beasts.

actions.name: Identify Construct, Dragon, or Magical Beast
actions.description: Recall vulnerabilities, resistances, and special attacks of arcane beasts and constructs (DC 15 + creature HD).

actions.name: Recall Ancient Arcane Mysteries and Eldritch Lore
actions.description: Remember obscure arcane traditions, planar leyline connections, and lost spell formulas.
